type: Still life in the style of Cézanne
description: We recreated Cézanne's still life style in 3D by incorporating multiple perspectives into key views.
We adjusted the position and shape of facial features—ears, head, mouth, eyes, and nose—for specific views.
To improve realism, we added folds to the dress without strictly following physical plausibility.
A 2D caricature of Einstein was used to generate a 3D model. We then manually adjusted facial features to better match the original drawing, without introducing artifacts in other views.
As the camera lowers, a trapezoidal shape helps the house appear towering over a kid.
We corrected the model to better align with a side-view 2D sketch.
We edit the viking model’s profile—refining the nose, enlarging the mustache, softening the hair, and angling the horn—while keeping the front view unchanged.
